questionText: Will npm downloads of @supabase/supabase-js in the 7 days ending November 8, 2026 (UTC) be at least 35,000,000?

method.name: log-trend-theil-sen
method.description: Fits a straight-line trend to log(1 + weekly total) over the most recent weeks (Theil–Sen, robust to spikes), projects it from the last complete week to the question window, and converts the distance to the threshold into a probability using a normal distribution: p = 1 − Φ((ln(1+T) − μ) / σ). The trend is damped and the result is pulled slightly toward 50% (settings chosen by backtest), so it never reaches 0% or 100%. A persistent jump or drop in level (e.g. a change in how downloads are counted) restarts the fit after the jump. With fewer than 8 weeks of data the result is pulled further toward 50% and the band widens. The band is model uncertainty (10th–90th percentile across refits on resampled data), not a range for the outcome. Trades never feed the model.
